<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Api;

use App\CircuitBreaker\CircuitBreaker;
use App\CircuitBreaker\CircuitState;
use App\Logging\AuditLogger;
use App\Auth\TokenValidator;

class MobileApiController
{
    private CircuitBreaker $circuitBreaker;
    private AuditLogger $logger;
    private TokenValidator $tokenValidator;
    private string $logPath;

    public function __construct(
        CircuitBreaker $circuitBreaker,
        AuditLogger $logger,
        TokenValidator $tokenValidator,
        string $logPath = '/var/log/mobile-api/audit.log'
    ) {
        $this->circuitBreaker = $circuitBreaker;
        $this->logger = $logger;
        $this->tokenValidator = $tokenValidator;
        $this->logPath = $logPath;
    }

    public function handleRequest(array $request): array
    {
        $endpoint = $request['endpoint'] ?? '/unknown';
        $deviceId = $request['device_id'] ?? 'anonymous';
        $authToken = $request['auth_token'] ?? '';

        // Validate auth token
        if (!$this->tokenValidator->validate($authToken)) {
            $this->logAuthFailure($deviceId, $endpoint);
            return ['status' => 401, 'error' => 'Unauthorized'];
        }

        // Check circuit breaker state
        $state = $this->circuitBreaker->getState($endpoint);
        if ($state === CircuitState::OPEN) {
            $this->logCircuitOpen($deviceId, $endpoint);
            return ['status' => 503, 'error' => 'Service temporarily unavailable'];
        }

        try {
            $result = $this->dispatchToBackend($endpoint, $request);
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordSuccess($endpoint);
            $this->logSuccess($deviceId, $endpoint);
            return ['status' => 200, 'data' => $result];
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordFailure($endpoint);
            $this->logFailure($deviceId, $endpoint, $e);
            return ['status' => 500, 'error' => 'Internal error'];
        }
    }

    private function logAuthFailure(string $deviceId, string $endpoint): void
    {
        $sanitizedEndpoint = $this->sanitizeForLog($endpoint);
        $context = $this->buildLogContext($deviceId, $sanitizedEndpoint);
        $this->logger->warning('AUTH_FAILURE', $context);
    }

    private function logCircuitOpen(string $deviceId, string $endpoint): void
    {
        $sanitizedEndpoint = $this->sanitizeForLog($endpoint);
        $context = $this->buildLogContext($deviceId, $sanitizedEndpoint);
        $this->logger->info('CIRCUIT_OPEN', $context);
    }

    private function logSuccess(string $deviceId, string $endpoint): void
    {
        $sanitizedEndpoint = $this->sanitizeForLog($endpoint);
        $context = $this->buildLogContext($deviceId, $sanitizedEndpoint);
        $this->logger->info('REQUEST_SUCCESS', $context);
    }

    private function logFailure(string $deviceId, string $endpoint, \Exception $e): void
    {
        $sanitizedEndpoint = $this->sanitizeForLog($endpoint);
        $context = $this->buildLogContext($deviceId, $sanitizedEndpoint);
        $context['error_class'] = get_class($e);
        $context['error_code'] = $e->getCode();
        $this->logger->error('REQUEST_FAILURE', $context);
    }

    private function buildLogContext(string $deviceId, string $endpoint): array
    {
        return [
            'device_id' => $deviceId,
            'endpoint' => $endpoint,
            'timestamp' => gmdate('Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z'),
            'circuit_state' => $this->circuitBreaker->getStateLabel(),
        ];
    }

    private function sanitizeForLog(string $input): string
    {
        // Remove control characters that could inject log entries
        $cleaned = preg_replace('/[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F]/', '', $input);
        // Truncate to reasonable length
        return substr($cleaned, 0, 256);
    }

    private function dispatchToBackend(string $endpoint, array $request): array
    {
        // Simulated backend dispatch
        return ['dispatched' => true];
    }
}

class AuditLogger
{
    private string $logFile;
    private string $appName;

    public function __construct(string $logFile, string $appName = 'mobile-api')
    {
        $this->logFile = $logFile;
        $this->appName = $appName;
    }

    public function info(string $event, array $context): void
    {
        $this->writeLog('INFO', $event, $context);
    }

    public function warning(string $event, array $context): void
    {
        $this->writeLog('WARNING', $event, $context);
    }

    public function error(string $event, array $context): void
    {
        $this->writeLog('ERROR', $event, $context);
    }

    private function writeLog(string $level, string $event, array $context): void
    {
        $deviceId = $context['device_id'] ?? 'unknown';
        $endpoint = $context['endpoint'] ?? 'unknown';
        $timestamp = $context['timestamp'] ?? gmdate('Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z');
        $circuitState = $context['circuit_state'] ?? 'unknown';

        $logLine = sprintf(
            "[%s] %s %s.%s device=%s endpoint=%s circuit=%s",
            $timestamp,
            $level,
            $this->appName,
            $event,
            $this->encodeLogValue($deviceId),
            $this->encodeLogValue($endpoint),
            $circuitState
        );

        if (isset($context['error_class'])) {
            $logLine .= sprintf(' error=%s', $this->encodeLogValue($context['error_class']));
        }

        $logLine .= PHP_EOL;
        file_put_contents($this->logFile, $logLine, FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
    }

    private function encodeLogValue(string $value): string
    {
        // Encode spaces, special chars, and all control characters including newlines
        $value = str_replace('\\', '\\\\', $value);
        $value = str_replace(' ', '\\_', $value);
        $value = str_replace('"', '\\"', $value);
        $value = str_replace("\n", '\\n', $value);
        $value = str_replace("\r", '\\r', $value);
        return $value;
    }
}

class CircuitBreaker
{
    private array $failures = [];
    private array $states = [];
    private int $threshold;
    private int $timeout;

    public function __construct(int $threshold = 5, int $timeout = 30)
    {
        $this->threshold = $threshold;
        $this->timeout = $timeout;
    }

    public function getState(string $service): string
    {
        return $this->states[$service] ?? CircuitState::CLOSED;
    }

    public function getStateLabel(): string
    {
        return 'operational';
    }

    public function recordSuccess(string $service): void
    {
        $this->failures[$service] = 0;
        $this->states[$service] = CircuitState::CLOSED;
    }

    public function recordFailure(string $service): void
    {
        $count = ($this->failures[$service] ?? 0) + 1;
        $this->failures[$service] = $count;
        if ($count >= $this->threshold) {
            $this->states[$service] = CircuitState::OPEN;
        }
    }
}

class CircuitState
{
    public const CLOSED = 'closed';
    public const OPEN = 'open';
    public const HALF_OPEN = 'half_open';
}

class TokenValidator
{
    private string $secret;

    public function __construct(string $secret)
    {
        $this->secret = $secret;
    }

    public function validate(string $token): bool
    {
        if (empty($token)) {
            return false;
        }
        return hash_equals(
            hash_hmac('sha256', substr($token, 0, 32), $this->secret),
            substr($token, 32)
        );
    }
}
